declarations.type:
∀ {first second third : SearchRouteBranchBound.GraphLowerBound},
  SearchRouteBranchBound.keyLexNoWorse first second →
    SearchRouteBranchBound.keyLexNoWorse second third → SearchRouteBranchBound.keyLexNoWorse first third
declarations.name: SearchRouteBranchBound.keyLexNoWorse_trans

declarations.type:
∀ {selected : SearchRouteDAG.GraphCandidate} {frontier : SearchRouteBranchBound.CertifiedFrontier},
  SearchRouteBranchBound.Prunable selected frontier.lowerBound →
    ∀ (candidate : SearchRouteDAG.GraphCandidate),
      candidate ∈ frontier.candidates → SearchRouteDAG.graphLexNoWorse selected candidate
declarations.name: SearchRouteBranchBound.valid_lower_bound_pruning_is_safe

declarations.type:
∀ {selected : SearchRouteDAG.GraphCandidate} {candidateUniverse : SearchRouteBranchBound.CandidateUniverse}
  {visible : List SearchRouteDAG.GraphCandidate},
  SearchRouteBranchBound.VisibleOptimal selected visible →
    ∀ (receipt : SearchRouteBranchBound.CoverageReceipt candidateUniverse visible),
      SearchRouteBranchBound.DeferredPrunable selected receipt →
        ∀ (candidate : SearchRouteDAG.GraphCandidate),
          candidate ∈ candidateUniverse.candidates → SearchRouteDAG.graphLexNoWorse selected candidate
declarations.name: SearchRouteBranchBound.certified_lazy_frontier_is_globally_optimal

declarations.type:
∀ {candidateUniverse : SearchRouteBranchBound.CandidateUniverse} {visible : List SearchRouteDAG.GraphCandidate}
  (receipt : SearchRouteBranchBound.CoverageReceipt candidateUniverse visible) (currentSnapshotDigest : Nat),
  SearchRouteBranchBound.snapshotMatchesB receipt currentSnapshotDigest = true ↔
    candidateUniverse.snapshotDigest = currentSnapshotDigest
declarations.name: SearchRouteBranchBound.snapshotMatchesB_true_iff

declarations.type:
∀ {selected : SearchRouteDAG.GraphCandidate} {candidateUniverse : SearchRouteBranchBound.CandidateUniverse}
  {visible : List SearchRouteDAG.GraphCandidate}
  (receipt : SearchRouteBranchBound.CoverageReceipt candidateUniverse visible) (currentSnapshotDigest : Nat),
  SearchRouteBranchBound.snapshotMatchesB receipt currentSnapshotDigest = true →
    SearchRouteBranchBound.VisibleOptimal selected visible →
      SearchRouteBranchBound.DeferredPrunable selected receipt →
        ∀ (candidate : SearchRouteDAG.GraphCandidate),
          candidate ∈ candidateUniverse.candidates → SearchRouteDAG.graphLexNoWorse selected candidate
declarations.name: SearchRouteBranchBound.snapshot_accepted_lazy_frontier_is_globally_optimal

declarations.type:
SearchRouteBranchBound.VisibleOptimal SearchRouteDAG.shortInteractionLongGraph
    [SearchRouteDAG.shortInteractionLongGraph] ∧
  ¬∀ (candidate : SearchRouteDAG.GraphCandidate),
      candidate ∈ [SearchRouteDAG.shortInteractionLongGraph, SearchRouteDAG.longInteractionShortGraph] →
        SearchRouteDAG.graphLexNoWorse SearchRouteDAG.shortInteractionLongGraph candidate
declarations.name: SearchRouteBranchBound.visible_optimality_without_coverage_is_unsound
